Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick follow-up — ACME asked us to wind down their POC tomorrow. Need owners for hosted API key rotation, dedicated pool dealloc, VPC bridge removal, and log retention. Can we confirm steps + ETA?
Alex (Sales): They're ready to close. I'll handle billing reconciliation and share final invoice. @Kevin can you confirm pool dealloc steps?
Kevin (Infra): Yes. High level: drain pool -> wait for inflight to finish (max ~15m) -> delete pool. Commands: ```redwoodctl pool drain --id pool-abc123 && redwoodctl pool delete --id pool-abc123``` Export logs first: ```redwoodctl logs export --pool pool-abc123 --range 90d --out s3://acme-poc-logs```
Priya (Security): Security checklist: rotate hosted API key, revoke service creds for the pool, export KMS audit logs, and run a data purge for KV cache / contexts. We'll need evidence of rotation + deletion for the questionnaire.
Marta (Customer Success): Customer wants transcripts retained 30 days, raw logs 90 days. They also want a signed attestation that we deleted model context and any PII after teardown. I'll coordinate that.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Who owns key invalidation? I can rotate hosted keys but need infra to revoke pool service creds. Also need confirmation on whether we snapshot model cache for dev debugging.
Kevin (Infra): I will revoke pool service creds after drain completes. If you need a cache snapshot, do it before purge. Purge command (destructive): ```redwoodctl data purge --pool pool-abc123 --type kv-cache --confirm```
Alex (Sales): I can rotate the hosted API key in the console. I'll tag the old key with `revoked:<date>` and schedule deletion in 7 days. Will upload rotation proof to secure portal. :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): For the questionnaire answer: "PII and context handling" — we purge KV-cache and session context at teardown, export logs per contract, then delete platform copies per retention policy. We'll attach the logs export + S3 lifecycle policy.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll draft the attestation doc (short) and send to ACME for signature. They asked for the attestation to include timestamps and rotation IDs.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Proposed sequence (start 09:00 PST tomorrow): 1) Export logs & transcripts (Marta) 2) Rotate hosted key (Alex) 3) Drain pool & revoke service creds (Kevin) 4) Purge KV-cache & contexts (Kevin) 5) Confirm S3 lifecycle and retention (Marta) 6) Deliver attestation (Marta/Priya). ETA ~1h30.
Alex (Sales): On billing — I'll close out usage and confirm no reserved commit charges after pool deletion. Will send final PO.
Kevin (Infra): Note: if customer wants a model cache snapshot for postmortem, we must take before purge. Otherwise proceed with purge.
Marta (Customer Success): ACME POC lead prefers 10:30 PST finish. I'll confirm and set calendar invite for 09:15 check-in.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PST — tagging ticket PROD-4567.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll create a concise runbook for ops with the critical commands and links. Stack of commands for on-call: ```# export logs
redwoodctl logs export --pool pool-abc123 --range 90d --out s3://acme-poc-logs
# rotate hosted key
redwoodctl keys rotate --id hosted-poc-acme
# drain and delete pool
redwoodctl pool drain --id pool-abc123 && sleep 900 && redwoodctl pool delete --id pool-abc123
# purge all POC data
redwoodctl data purge --pool pool-abc123 --type all --confirm```
Priya (Security): Also capture KMS rotation audit and upload to compliance folder. I'll fetch after Alex rotates.
Alex (Sales): Will upload rotation evidence to secure portal and drop link here when done.
Marta (Customer Success): Attestation draft uploaded to shared drive, waiting for Priya review.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Sounds good. Please react with :white_check_mark: once your step is complete so I can close the runbook and notify the customer.
